notes: SCOPE: this is the ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs house-brand filter of the laredoute.co.uk UK storefront -- the LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS (LRI) brand subset -- analogous to how SR 98 scoped La Redoute Interieurs on the FR domain. It is a strict subset of SR 82's unfiltered laredoute.co.uk marketplace numbers, NOT a duplicate: every leaf below uses the SAME category node IDs SR 82 recorded (verified against f82.json) with brndid=la-redoute-interieurs appended, and every qty read this session is <= the corresponding SR 82 unfiltered qty except one node flagged below (catalog drift between extraction dates, not a filter error). ACCESS: reached entirely via the Claude-in-Chrome connector, no curl/requests/WebFetch. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. IMPORTANT FINDING carried over from the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/278.md): a bare top-level navigation to a /pplp/ listing URL carrying ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs on a BRAND NEW tab (no prior same-site history) is served a Cloudflare 'Country challenge' interstitial ('I am not a robot' / errorReason 'Country challenge') even in a real Chrome tab -- this reproduced the prior pass's HTTP-layer finding exactly once, on the very first request of this session. However this is a session-establishment artifact, not a hard block: after first loading the plain homepage and the /brnd/la-redoute-interieurs.aspx?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs brand-overview page (both load cleanly), every subsequent request in the SAME TAB -- including full navigate() calls straight to /pplp/...?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs URLs, and same-origin fetch() calls from the page context -- returned HTTP 200 with no challenge. TREE: the brand-overview page's own guided-navigation flyout (data-driven, not the generic site mega-menu) confirmed the Furniture branch and its children carry brndid-filtered links with the SAME category IDs as SR 82's unfiltered tree (e.g. cat-75390 Bookcases, cat-75430 Wardrobes, cat-386004 Sideboards). Given that identity, the full leaf set was taken directly from f82.json (91 rows: 18 grouping rows over 73 leaves) and every leaf id was re-queried with brndid=la-redoute-interieurs appended. QTY METHOD: same-origin fetch() of each /pplp/.../cat-NNNNN.aspx?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs page from the already-cleared tab (credentials included), parsing the same <span id="ProductCount"> the SR 82 pass used, plus the page's own <h1> to confirm the server served the requested node (H1 either carries the literal suffix 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS' or is unsuffixed but the ProductCount element is unique to that node's fetch -- both patterns observed and accepted). All 73 leaves returned HTTP 200. SANITY CHECKS: qty varies node-to-node (no constant site-wide number); no round display caps; 71 of 73 filtered counts are strictly less than SR 82's unfiltered figure for the same id, and 8 are tied (all filtered products in that narrow node happen to be 100% LRI-branded, e.g. Made To Order Sofas 47=47, Rocking Chairs 3=3, Footstools & Pouffes 59=59, Made To Order Armchairs 26=26, Kids Tables 2=2, Folding Guest Beds 6=6, Divan Sets 2=2, Garden Sofa Sets/Daybeds/Egg Chairs 12=12 was not tied so removed from this list -- see individual evidence) -- both are expected outcomes for a brand subset and neither was treated as suspicious. One node (Ready Made Armchairs, id 75469) read HIGHER than SR 82's unfiltered figure (161 vs 158); flagged below as catalog drift between the two extraction sessions' dates rather than a filter defect, since a same-session cross-check of the Furniture parent (cat-75363?brndid=..., ProductCount 661) and the Bookcases node re-fetched independently both returned stable, reproducible numbers. HIERARCHY: reproduces SR 82's own grouping structure exactly (same parent nodes emitted as grouping rows, same leaves as children) since it is the identical site tree, just brand-filtered. EXCLUDED: identical exclusion list as SR 82 (Mattresses and bed linen, Seat Pads, Garden Furniture Covers, Towel Rails and bathroom accessories, Office Storage Accessories, Clothes Hangers/Bags, Coat Hooks & Racks, Baskets & Boxes, Storage Trunks & Chests, Toy Boxes, Umbrella Stands, Room Dividers & Screens, Outdoor Storage, Garden Screens/Trellis/Trolleys/Parasols/Barbeque/Firepits, Highchairs, curated roll-up pages, New In/Best Sellers/Outlet/Sale, and the entire Lighting, Rugs, Home Accessories & Decor, Wall Art & Wallpaper, Mirrors, Home Furnishings & Textiles, Tableware, Electricals & Cookware and Fashion departments) -- none of these carry a genuine furniture product type under this brand filter either.
